nodes.summary: The unique strictly decreasing tuple of positive natural numbers of length zero, namely the empty tuple.
nodes.title: Empty strictly decreasing tuple

nodes.summary: The unique weakly decreasing tuple of positive natural numbers of length zero, namely the empty tuple.
nodes.title: Empty weakly decreasing tuple

nodes.summary: The empty multiple-zeta index, which has no entries and weight zero.
nodes.title: Empty multiple-zeta index

nodes.summary: For a multiple-zeta index $k = (k_0, \dots, k_{d-1})$ of depth $d$ and $0 \le i < d$, the entry of $k$ at $i$ is the positive natural number $k_i$.
nodes.title: Entry of a multiple-zeta index

nodes.summary: A multiple-zeta index is admissible or empty when it is admissible (nonempty with first entry at least two) or has depth zero, that is, has no entries.
nodes.title: Admissible or empty index

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$ and every positive natural number $e \ge 2$, the index $\{e\}^k$ consisting of $k$ entries all equal to $e$ is admissible or empty.
nodes.title: Repeated indices with entry at least two are admissible or empty

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k$ and a positive natural number $e$, the index $\{e\}^k = (e, \dots, e)$ consisting of $k$ entries all equal to $e$, so of weight $ke$.
nodes.title: Repeated index

nodes.summary: For a multiple-zeta index $k$ of depth $d$ and a strictly decreasing tuple $m$ of $d$ positive natural numbers, the star summand of $k$ at $m$, with $m$ regarded as a weakly decreasing tuple, equals the strict summand of $k$ at $m$.
nodes.title: Star and strict summands agree on strictly decreasing tuples

nodes.summary: For a multiple-zeta index $k = (k_0, \dots, k_{d-1})$ of depth $d$ and a weakly decreasing tuple $m = (m_0, \dots, m_{d-1})$ of positive natural numbers, the star summand of $k$ at $m$ is the real number $\left(\prod_{i\lt d} m_i^{k_i}\right)^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Multiple-zeta-star summand

nodes.summary: The multiple-zeta-star value of the empty index is $1$.
nodes.title: Multiple-zeta-star value of the empty index

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbf{k} = (k_0, \dots, k_{r-1})$ be an index of depth $r$ that is admissible ($r \ge 1$ and $k_0 \ge 2$) or empty. Its multiple zeta-star value is the real number
nodes.title: Multiple zeta-star value

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, a strictly decreasing $r$-tuple is a tuple $(m_0, \dots, m_{r-1})$ of positive integers with $m_0 > m_1 > \dots > m_{r-1}$.
nodes.title: Strictly decreasing tuples

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbf{k} = (k_0, \dots, k_{r-1})$ be an index of depth $r$ and let $(m_0, \dots, m_{r-1})$ be a strictly decreasing $r$-tuple of positive integers. The summand attached to $\mathbf{k}$ and this tuple is the real number $\left(\prod_{i=0}^{r-1} m_i^{k_i}\right)^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Multiple zeta summand

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbf{k} = (k_0, \dots, k_{r-1})$ be an index of depth $r$ that is admissible ($r \ge 1$ and $k_0 \ge 2$) or empty. Its multiple zeta value is the real number
nodes.title: Multiple zeta value

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, every strictly decreasing $r$-tuple $(m_0, \dots, m_{r-1})$ of positive integers is weakly decreasing; this map sends it to the same tuple, regarded as a weakly decreasing $r$-tuple.
nodes.title: Strictly decreasing tuples as weakly decreasing tuples

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, a weakly decreasing $r$-tuple is a tuple $(m_0, \dots, m_{r-1})$ of positive integers with $m_0 \ge m_1 \ge \dots \ge m_{r-1}$.
nodes.title: Weakly decreasing tuples

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
